meta.description: Comprehensive reference mapping of a 5-layer integrated research plan to curated literature, establishing a causal logic chain from technical contributions to empirical evidence.

research_questions: RQ1.1: How can Transformer-based architectures be optimized for bilingual ESG ABSA?
RQ1.3: How can regional calibration and ESG lexicons mitigate bias?

literature_references.title: AdaMergeX: Cross-Lingual Transfer with Large Language Models via Adaptive Adapter Merging
literature_references.authors: Yiran Zhao, Wenxuan Zhang, Sheng Wang, Kenji Kawaguchi, Lidong Bing
literature_references.relevance: Provides the causal mechanism for C3 and RQ1.1 by proposing a method to decouple task ability from language ability, enabling effective cross-lingual transfer between high-resource and target languages like Indonesian.

literature_references.title: Multilingual Machine Translation with Open Large Language Models at Practical Scale: An Empirical Study
literature_references.relevance: Supports C1 and C9 by evaluating 9B parameter models on 28 languages, establishing the empirical performance baselines for the foundational bilingual platform.

contributions: C8: Large-scale ESG LLM benchmark (30+ models)
research_questions: RQ2.1: To what extent does few-shot learning improve ESG granularity?
RQ2.2: How can long-context mechanisms enhance scalability?
RQ2.4: How can multi-LLM fusion reduce hallucination?

literature_references.title: HMT: Hierarchical Memory Transformer for Efficient Long Context Language Processing
literature_references.authors: Zifan He, Yingqi Cao, Zongyue Qin, Neha Prakriya, Yizhou Sun, Jason Cong
literature_references.relevance: Supports C13 and RQ2.2 by imitating human memory hierarchy to enable efficient processing of long ESG disclosures with significantly fewer parameters.

literature_references.title: Active Few-Shot Learning for Text Classification
literature_references.authors: Saeed Ahmadnia, Arash Yousefi Jordehi, Mahsa Hosseini Khasheh Heyran, S. Mirroshandel, Owen Rambow, Cornelia Caragea
literature_references.relevance: Direct evidence for RQ2.1 and C16, demonstrating that an active learning-based instance selection mechanism improves the performance of few-shot learning in data-sparse domains.

research_questions: RQ3.1: How can symbolic reasoning be integrated using ESG ontologies?
RQ3.2: How can transparent outputs be ensured via reasoning graphs?
RQ3.3: How can implicit ESG claims be identified?

literature_references.title: Verify-in-the-Graph: Entity Disambiguation Enhancement for Complex Claim Verification with Interactive Graph Representation
literature_references.authors: Hoang Pham, Thanh-Do Nguyen, Khac-Hoai Nam Bui
literature_references.relevance: Supports C7 and RQ3.2/3.3 by leveraging interactive graph representations to resolve ambiguous entities and provide deep sub-claim verification.

literature_references.title: XPrompt: Explaining Large Language Model's Generation via Joint Prompt Attribution
literature_references.authors: Yurui Chang, Bochuan Cao, Yujia Wang, Jinghui Chen, Lu Lin
literature_references.relevance: Provides structural evidence for C15 and RQ3.2, offering a counterfactual framework to explain the combined influence of prompts on model outputs.

research_questions: RQ4.1: How can XAI improve stakeholder trust in ESG outputs?
RQ4.5: Can tone–outcome mismatch reliably indicate greenwashing?

literature_references.title: Faithful, Unfaithful or Ambiguous? Multi-Agent Debate with Initial Stance for Summary Evaluation
literature_references.relevance: Directly supports RQ4.5 and C11 by introducing a multi-agent debate framework with initial stances to identify errors and ambiguities in generated narratives.

literature_references.title: Decoding Hate: Exploring Language Models' Reactions to Hate Speech
literature_references.relevance: Supports C14 and RQ4.1 by analyzing model reactions to toxic or biased inputs, essential for building trust in the risk intelligence layer.

research_questions: RQ5.1: How can transparent and auditable outputs be ensured?
RQ5.2: How can reasoning quality and consistency be operationalized at scale?

literature_references.title: PROMPTEVALS: A Dataset of Assertions and Guardrails for Custom Production Large Language Model Pipelines
literature_references.relevance: Provides the dataset and assertion criteria for RQ5.1 and C5 to improve reliability and auditability in production-level data processing pipelines.

literature_references.title: Towards Sustainable NLP: Insights from Benchmarking Inference Energy in Large Language Models
literature_references.relevance: Supports RQ5.2 and C12 by providing a comprehensive benchmark for inference energy, essential for optimizing system scalability in deployment.
